tasks.description: Update the manager surface so it reads the version created during the deploy phase, displays that version number, and clearly indicates when the displayed version is newly created.

tasks.title: Address review for [architecture-agent] Implement When you click deploy it will check a custom command
tasks.description:
The required deterministic wrapper check (`npm run typecheck`) passed, and the branch appears mergeable with `origin/dev`. The implementation adds deploy-hook support, but it does not complete the repo-specific deploy wiring requested by the task.
Blocking: the deploy hook only runs when `deployCommand` is present in config (`src/autonomy-v2/commands/deploy.ts:20`), but this branch does not add a `deployCommand` to this repo's config. `prompts/autonomous/v2/config/control-plane.json:1` still only contains repo metadata and deployment labels, and `prompts/autonomous/v2/config/agents.json:1` has no fallback `deployCommand` either. As a result, clicking Deploy in this repo will still only fast-forward/push `main`; it will not call the requested Heroku deploy command.

tasks.title: Address review for [architecture-agent] Implement When PRDs run The task bar should reflect in steps
tasks.description:
The required wrapper check `npm run typecheck` passed and the branch appears mergeable with `origin/dev`, but the PRD step logic has a blocking correctness issue.
`src/autonomy-v2/control-plane/status-view.ts:158` marks the run as `reviewing` whenever any active PR exists, without checking whether the selected PRD still has unfinished tasks or whether the PR belongs to that PRD. The new unit test at `tests/unit/control-plane-dashboard.test.ts:148-155` codifies the bug by expecting `reviewing` while the active PRD is only 1/3 complete. This will make the task bar skip/misreport the implementing step for PRDs that still have remaining implementation work. Expected correction: keep PRDs with remaining tasks in `implementing`, and only move to `reviewing` when the current PRD's implementation work is complete or its current review PR is actually active. Add focused coverage for a partially completed PRD with an active PR remaining in `implementing`.
